How to choose the Urdu edition

Choose Urdu Subtitles beside the Great Nation player. Urdu Dubbed is a different audio edition. If a search result uses a Roman Urdu series name such as Sultan Muhammad Fateh, check the original episode number as well as the language label.

Release dates and availability

The publisher verified the released Urdu and English editions of Episodes 1–4, original Episodes 84–87, on 13 October 2026. Episode 5, original Episode 88, remains upcoming. Broadcast dates and subtitle upload times are separate.
